[2] NASAMS (Norwegian Advanced Surface to Air Missile System) is a distributed and networked medium to long range air-defence system.
[3] No. 330 Squadron RNoAF (Norwegian: "330 skvadron" ) is a helicopter unit of the Royal Norwegian Air Force (RNoAF) and is Norway's military search and rescue service.
